purpose: Recompute corrected frozen S0 entry/exit decisions against the ACTUAL evolving capped per-leg hypothetical account. Falsify PR70 fixed-signal results; no profits promised.
no_future_volume: Use only the last fully completed bar's quoted-volume proxy for capped-leg veto; never current bar completed volume at its open. This is not on-chain order-book liquidity or an executable AMM quote.
source_timing: Signal after completed four-hour bar t; hypothetical attempt at next 4h candle OPEN. Actual next-open gaps may cause quantity reduction or veto. Pending risk-reducing exits continue, one <=25USD sell per observed next-open; never force-liquidate terminal inventory.
original_signal_policy: Use immutable SHA/blob pinned PR17 S0 ScreenPolicy and its frozen features, recomputing decisions from evolving cash, actual entered quantity and modeled marked equity. Alternate account ledger independent from original fixed-signal engine.
close_policy: A frozen original exit signal switches to persistent pending liquidation. Stop logic is evaluated only when position is not already pending exit; exit attempts do not consume entry quota. Every actual sell leg accrues separate cost.
caveats: Previously observed history, no independent final OOS
Original policy reused, alternative order-fill engine independent
Fills are next-open candle-price hypothetical with model costs, not validated DEX execution
Market impact, L1/L2, failed broadcast gas and quote-to-inclusion slippage UNKNOWN
Posthoc winner removal is concentration diagnosis, not executable counterfactual
No forward paper days and no capital authorization
predeclared_decision: Financial NO-GO regardless of signs. Compare to 2025 fixed-signal transfer only descriptively, cash and 20pct buy-and-hold where source-valid. Any missing data/gas is INSUFFICIENT_DATA for execution readiness.
